visualCharacteristics: An interactive testimonials switcher on a light background: a centered row of image-based tab buttons (customer logos/avatars) switches between testimonial panels. Each panel shows a customer image, a pull-quote, the customer name and title, and a 'Visit Site' CTA.
contentPattern: One row per testimonial panel. Each row's first image becomes its image tab button; the remaining cell holds the quote, attribution, and CTA.
usage: Customer testimonial / case-study switchers keyed by brand logo tabs.
